environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB with AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes the AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode (not blocking), and a custom rule group 'tenant-app-xss-mitigations' with priority 1 that inspects QUERY_STRING using a regex pattern set matching common script injection vectors (angle brackets, javascript: URIs, event handlers) with action BLOCK. Additionally, the ALB has a fixed-response rule on path /search that injects a Content-Security-Policy: script-src 'nonce-{random}' header via Lambda@Edge association on the CloudFront distribution sitting in front of the ALB. The CloudFront distribution has a response headers policy (ID: 67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03) that adds Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' to all responses from the /search* path pattern. PostgreSQL RLS remains active for tenant isolation.

waf_rules: Custom rule group 'tenant-app-xss-mitigations' priority 1, regex pattern set on QUERY_STRING, action BLOCK
config.response_headers_policy: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' on /search* path pattern
config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON users USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet, CloudFront origin
